item.summary: The Centre for Research on International Trade (CRIT), New Delhi, in partnership with the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT), New Delhi, organised a three-day Orientation Course on Trade Negotiations from 28 to 30 September 2026 in New Delhi. item.title: CRIT and IIFT Organise Three-Day Orientation Course on Trade Negotiations
